segments.name: Mobile games
segments.description: Operates a portfolio of free-to-play mobile games with live operations services for players worldwide.
segments.evidence: We are one of the world's leading operators of mobile games creating fun, innovative experiences that entertain and engage our users.

revenueModel.text: Players pay for in-game virtual items in free-to-play games, with fees collected by platform providers or payment processors and remitted to the Company.
revenueModel.evidence: Deferred revenues, which represent a contract liability, represent mostly unrecognized fees billed for virtual items which have not yet been consumed at the balance sheet date.
